objectives.statement: Recognize that Norwegian often uses the normal present for English present continuous, and adds activity frames only when the ongoing action needs emphasis.
Choose and understand the frames holder på å, driver og, and sitter og for ongoing activity.
Build correct sentences with holde på å plus infinitive and drive, sitte, stå, or ligge plus og and a tense-marked verb.
Use the same frames in the simple past to show an action that was in progress at a past time.

notes: Must teach Norwegian activity-frame constructions that correspond to the English present continuous: holde på å (holder på å spise), drive og (driver og leser), and sitte/stå/ligge og (sitter og jobber). Emphasise that Norwegian has no dedicated progressive tense and these frames are optional, used to highlight ongoing activity.
